definition-dropped.answer: §2002:8.4.2.7 'NULL is a predefined object reference that contains the null object reference value' is word for word §2023:8.4.3.7.1, and the §2002:4 object reference ('explicitly- or implicitly-defined data item that contains a reference to an object') matches §2023:9.3.2. So what the rule excludes (universal object references, NULL) is the same in 2002, and the reader's 2002 probes stand.
